$comment: The Tavern frontend gate's contract. Authority: design/architecture/tavern-frontend-criteria.md. This file is what makes a frontend requirement impossible to delete quietly: the surface list here must equal the pane inventory derived from the shell entry, every declared suite must exist and run at least its declared number of tests, every declared criterion must be exercised, and a disabled test fails the gate instead of reducing it.

surfaceInventory.rule: Every profile the shell can render is a surface: the gate derives them from the shell's own branch map and requires this file to declare exactly those, so adding a pane without declaring it fails, and so does declaring a pane that no longer exists.

suites.capability: B5 Chat lifecycle in the browser: live SSE, durable cancellation, replay and recovery
B4/B5/B6 Chat surface: a real provider turn, the same conversation across an app restart, the operability floor

surfaces.criteriaTitle: conformance: chat surface meets the frontend criteria

suites.capability: Game surface composition, lifecycle and STOP/Resume projections

surfaces.deferredReason: The game pane's own criteria run needs a real Stardew installation and belongs to the game lane. This deferral names the suites that cover it today and the gate verifies they exist, so the deferral cannot hide a deleted suite.

suites.capability: B1-B3 P9 management surface: World Info, connections, characters, the reviewed card import and the companion language

surfaces.criteriaTitle: conformance: management surface meets the frontend criteria

requiredTitles: conformance: chat surface meets the frontend criteria
conformance: management surface meets the frontend criteria
management browser imports a reviewed character card and provisions the companion it names
management browser sets the companion language once, durably, and the runtime reads it
reference browser mounts the reference surface with live SSE and cookie reload
reference browser is keyboard operable and does not overflow at phone or desktop width
reference browser sends a message to the real provider and keeps the answer across a reload
reference browser keeps the conversation across an app restart on the same root
credentialTestTitles: reference browser sends a message to the real provider and keeps the answer across a reload
